title: Bilateral Trade Volume and Share Trend (2018-2024)
executive_question: Has China's share of EU imports peaked and started declining?
comparison_set: EU imports from other top partners (US, UK, Switzerland) for context.
search_queries: Eurostat EU imports from China 2018 2023
EU extra-EU imports by partner 2023
China share of EU imports 2024 estimate
data_quality_rule: Use official Eurostat data; if 2024 data is preliminary, note as estimate. Require at least 4 annual observations; if only 2 endpoints, use CAGR from 2018-2023 and apply to 2024 as estimate.
narrative_role: Establishes the macro trend of trade decoupling.
pre_exhibit_context: Claim: China's share of EU imports has peaked and is declining due to de-risking policies.
post_exhibit_takeaway: China's share of EU imports declined from 22.4% in 2020 to 20.5% in 2023, supporting the decoupling narrative.

title: FDI Flows: Chinese Investment in EU vs. European Investment in China (2018-2023)
executive_question: How have bilateral investment flows changed in recent years?
required_metrics: Source: Rhodium Group, MOFCOM, fDi Markets
comparison_set: None needed, but can add sector breakdown if available.
search_queries: Rhodium Group Chinese investment in Europe 2023
MOFCOM European FDI in China 2023
fDi Markets China EU FDI flows 2018 2023
data_quality_rule: Use Rhodium Group data for Chinese FDI; MOFCOM for European FDI. If data gaps exist, note as estimates. Require at least 4 annual observations; if only 2 endpoints, use CAGR from 2018-2023 and apply to 2024 as estimate.
narrative_role: Shows the shift in investment patterns and the impact of regulatory scrutiny.
pre_exhibit_context: Claim: European FDI in China is shifting from manufacturing to services and R&D, while Chinese investment in Europe faces increasing scrutiny.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Chinese FDI in Europe peaked in 2016 and declined sharply after 2019, while European FDI in China remained stable but shifted towards services.
